tenders.title: 128-slice CT scanner (1 unit)
tenders.brief: Replacement for the 16-slice unit in service since 2014. Bids opened 18-Sep-2026.

vendors.name: Meridian Imaging Systems Pvt Ltd
vendors.cmcCoverage: Comprehensive parts, labour and 1 tube replacement per contract; an extra tube is ₹42,00,000.
vendors.paymentTerms: 20% advance · 70% on delivery · 10% after installation sign-off
vendors.exclusions: Extra X-ray tubes beyond the one covered, dye injector consumables, and any site civil work.
vendors.installedBase: 3 units in Kerala — Kottayam, Thrissur, Kollam (references on request).
vendors.hiddenNote: Tube life on 128-slice systems at this hospital's scan volume typically runs 5–6 years — a second tube beyond the one CMC covers is likely before year 7.
vendors.quoteText: We are pleased to quote our 128-slice CT platform with 2-year comprehensive warranty including one tube replacement. CMC from year 3 covers parts, labour and preventive maintenance; a further tube beyond the one included is chargeable at prevailing rates. Installation and training (5 days, 2 engineers) are included; power backup arrangements remain the hospital's responsibility.

vendors.name: Suryodaya Health Technologies
vendors.cmcCoverage: Preventive maintenance visits only; the X-ray tube is not included.
vendors.exclusions: X-ray tube (replacement ₹38,00,000, 6-week lead time), dye injector, power backup and site preparation — hospital to arrange.
vendors.installedBase: 1 unit in Kochi (a private diagnostic chain), 4 units in Tamil Nadu.
vendors.hiddenNote: Lowest basic price, but the tube is fully excluded from CMC and warranty is only 1 year — budgeting one tube replacement roughly every 3 years pushes true running cost well past the quoted CMC.
vendors.quoteText: Our quote reflects an aggressive basic price with a lean 1-year standard warranty (tube warranted 1 year or 60,000 scans, whichever is earlier). CMC from year 2 is preventive-maintenance only; tube, power backup and civil work are excluded and to be arranged by the hospital. Delivery is our fastest at 10 weeks from PO.

vendors.name: Advitya Medisystems
vendors.cmcCoverage: Fully comprehensive including the tube, maximum 1 replacement per year.
vendors.paymentTerms: 15% advance · 75% on delivery · 10% after 6-month performance review
vendors.exclusions: None stated beyond contrast dye and imaging paper.
vendors.installedBase: 6 units across South India, including 2 in Kerala.
vendors.hiddenNote: Highest basic price but the only quote with the tube fully inside CMC — least exposure to the tube-replacement trap.
vendors.quoteText: We offer 3-year comprehensive warranty (tube included) and a fully comprehensive CMC from year 4 that continues to cover tube replacement, capped at one per year. Freight and installation are included in the basic price. Delivery is longer than peers at 16 weeks given current order backlog.

vendors.name: Kavya Diagnostic Systems Pvt Ltd
vendors.cmcCoverage: Parts and labour; one tube per 2 years included.
vendors.exclusions: Annual detector calibration beyond the first visit, and dye-injector maintenance.
vendors.hiddenNote: CMC escalation (6%) is the steepest quoted — by year 7 the annual CMC alone exceeds ₹27L, before the calibration exclusion.
vendors.quoteText: A mid-priced, mid-delivery option: 2-year warranty with a tube every 2 years, CMC from year 3. Note our CMC carries a 6% annual escalation, higher than most competing quotes; detector calibration visits beyond the first year and dye-injector upkeep are billed separately.

tenders.title: ICU ventilators (6 units)
tenders.brief: ICU expansion — 6 ventilators for the new 10-bed critical care wing.

vendors.name: Amrutha Biomedical Solutions
vendors.cmcCoverage: Preventive maintenance and software updates across all 6 units.
vendors.exclusions: Humidifier chambers, breathing circuits and patient tubing — all consumables, hospital to procure separately (approx. ₹1,200 per patient-day).
vendors.hiddenNote: Lowest base price, but circuits and humidifiers are fully excluded — at typical ICU occupancy the consumable spend alone approaches the CMC value.
vendors.quoteText: Our ventilator platform is priced competitively for a 6-unit order. CMC from year 3 covers preventive maintenance and software; breathing circuits, humidifier chambers and tubing are consumables and excluded from both warranty and CMC, to be procured by the hospital on an ongoing basis.

vendors.name: Sanjeevani Medical Devices
vendors.cmcCoverage: Comprehensive incl. 2 reusable circuit sets per machine.
vendors.exclusions: Disposable HME filters only.
vendors.hiddenNote: Reusable circuits are included — only filters are excluded, the smallest hidden exposure of the four quotes.
vendors.quoteText: We include 2 reusable circuit sets per machine within the 3-year warranty and ongoing CMC, so recurring consumable spend is limited to disposable HME filters. Widest installed base among the bidders (20 units, 3 hospitals).

vendors.name: Vayudoot Critical Care Systems
vendors.exclusions: Breathing circuits, humidifiers and O2 sensors (₹18,000 each, replaced every 6–9 months).
vendors.hiddenNote: Cheapest on paper, but circuit, humidifier and O2-sensor exclusions make this the highest 7-year TCO — the ranking flips entirely.
vendors.quoteText: Aggressively priced for fast turnaround (6-week delivery). Warranty is 1 year and CMC from year 2 is basic preventive maintenance; circuits, humidifiers and O2 sensors are all excluded and consumed regularly in ICU use.

vendors.name: Praana Life Support
vendors.cmcCoverage: Parts and labour; circuits included in year 1–3.
vendors.exclusions: HME filters and battery packs, chargeable after year 3.
vendors.hiddenNote: A balanced quote — moderate price, moderate exclusions, kicking in only from year 4.
vendors.quoteText: A middle-of-the-road quote: circuits are bundled for the first 3 years, after which filters and battery packs are billed separately. Widest recent Kerala footprint (15 units, 4 hospitals) for reference calls.

tenders.title: Annual rate contract — surgical consumables
tenders.brief: Annual rate contract for OT sutures, gloves and drapes, standardised as a per-pack rate. Estimated consumption ~18,000 packs/year.

vendors.name: Keerthi Surgicals & Sutures
vendors.exclusions: Rate valid ex-factory; a raw-material (cotton, latex) price index move of over 5% triggers a quarterly rate-review clause.
vendors.installedBase: Existing RC vendor for FY25-26 at 2 VPS Lakeshore units.
vendors.hiddenNote: Lowest quoted rate, but the raw-material index clause was invoked twice in the last RC cycle — the effective rate rose about 9% intra-year both times.
vendors.quoteText: We quote our most competitive rate for the estimated annual basket, valid ex-factory. Please note the standard raw-material index clause: a documented move of over 5% in cotton or latex prices triggers a quarterly rate review, applied prospectively to that quarter's call-offs.

vendors.name: Om Sri Medical Supplies
vendors.exclusions: Rate fixed for the full RC period; no index or review clause.
vendors.installedBase: RC vendor to 4 hospitals in Kerala and Tamil Nadu.
vendors.hiddenNote: Slightly higher headline rate but genuinely fixed — no clause exposure, so the risk-adjusted cost is lower than it first appears.
vendors.quoteText: Our rate is fixed for the entire contract period with no index-linked review clause, giving budget certainty across the RC term. Standard 30-day credit terms against monthly consolidated invoicing.

vendors.name: Bhavani Hospital Consumables
vendors.exclusions: Packs supplied with roughly 60-day residual shelf life on arrival (industry norm is 180+ days); comparable hospitals report ~8% wastage/return on such short-dated stock.
vendors.installedBase: New empanelment — no existing installed base at VPS Lakeshore.
vendors.hiddenNote: Lowest rate on paper, but the short shelf life on arrival has driven material wastage at comparable hospitals — factoring an 8% wastage rate nearly erases the rate advantage.
vendors.quoteText: We offer the sharpest per-pack rate in this tender to win the empanelment. Stock typically arrives with about 60 days of shelf life remaining; stores should plan first-in-first-out issuance closely given the shorter runway than incumbent suppliers.

vendors.name: Trichur Surgical Traders
vendors.exclusions: Standard terms; no notable exclusions.
vendors.installedBase: RC vendor for 1 hospital in Thrissur.
vendors.hiddenNote: Middling rate with no notable hidden costs, but limited surge capacity — emergency top-up orders quoted at 7–10 days versus 3 days for the others.
vendors.quoteText: A steady, no-surprises quote at a middling rate. Our standard call-off lead time is 3 days for scheduled orders; emergency top-ups run 7–10 days given our smaller regional warehouse.

tenders.title: Dialysis machines (4 units)
tenders.brief: Dialysis unit expansion — 4 machines for the renal care programme.

vendors.name: Nefro Care Systems
vendors.cmcCoverage: Parts and labour on the machines only.
vendors.exclusions: Firmware locks dialyzers and bloodlines to OEM-branded consumables (open architecture disabled) — about ₹1,450/session versus ₹950/session for generic consumables on open-architecture makes.
vendors.hiddenNote: Cheapest machines, but firmware-locked consumables add an estimated ₹6L/year across 4 machines — over 7 years this is the single largest cost driver.
vendors.quoteText: Our 4-machine bundle is priced to win on capital cost. Please note our consumables (dialyzers, bloodlines) are firmware-matched to the machine for safety and warranty compliance; third-party consumables will not be accepted by the machine and will void warranty.

vendors.name: Amrita Renal Technologies
vendors.exclusions: Open architecture — accepts generic dialyzers and bloodlines; only priming sets are recommended as proprietary (optional).
vendors.hiddenNote: Open-architecture machines with no consumable lock-in — despite the higher sticker price, this is the lowest 7-year TCO.
vendors.quoteText: Our machines are open-architecture by design: any CE/BIS-certified dialyzer and bloodline set works without restriction, giving the hospital full sourcing flexibility for the life of the equipment.

vendors.name: Vitraya Medical Systems
vendors.exclusions: Dialyzer must be Vitraya-branded for warranty validity; bloodlines are open architecture.
vendors.hiddenNote: Partial lock-in — only the dialyzer is restricted — giving a moderate hidden-cost exposure between the two extremes.
vendors.quoteText: A mid-priced quote with partial openness: bloodlines can be sourced from any certified supplier, but the dialyzer must remain Vitraya-branded to keep the warranty valid.

vendors.name: Kaveri Biomedical
vendors.cmcCoverage: Comprehensive parts and labour, freight and installation included.
vendors.exclusions: Fully open architecture; standard reusable priming sets.
vendors.hiddenNote: Highest capital cost of the four, but a straightforward, low-risk quote with no consumable lock-in.
vendors.quoteText: Our price is at the higher end but is all-inclusive (freight and installation) with fully open consumable architecture and no hidden dependencies of any kind.

tenders.title: HIS servers & storage
tenders.brief: Server and SAN storage refresh for the Hospital Information System, ahead of the multi-site rollout.

vendors.name: Nova Infratech Solutions
vendors.cmcCoverage: Hardware AMC — parts and labour on servers and storage.
vendors.exclusions: Database and OS licensing billed separately per core, per year; migration/cutover services not included (estimated ₹18L one-time).
vendors.installedBase: HIS infrastructure at 2 hospitals in Kerala.
vendors.hiddenNote: Lowest hardware price, but per-core database licensing (billed separately, growing with usage) plus an uncosted migration fee materially change the 5-year number.
vendors.quoteText: This quote covers the physical server and SAN storage bundle only. Database (per-core) and OS licensing are billed by the OEM directly and are outside our scope; migration and cutover services can be arranged separately, estimated at ₹18 lakh.

vendors.name: Suchitra Systems Integrators
vendors.exclusions: Database and OS licensing bundled for the first 3 years only, then billed at the prevailing per-core rate; migration is included.
vendors.hiddenNote: Migration and 3-year licensing are bundled — cost is transparent until year 4, when licensing reverts to the prevailing per-core rate.
vendors.quoteText: Our bundle includes migration and 3 years of database/OS licensing at no extra charge, so there are no surprises through year 3. From year 4, licensing renews at the OEM's prevailing per-core rate, which we will notify in advance.

vendors.name: Meghna Datacore
vendors.exclusions: Storage array uses proprietary drive caddies (about 30% premium over standard drives); OS/DB licensing is separate; migration is not included.
vendors.installedBase: 1 hospital (a recent entrant to healthcare IT).
vendors.hiddenNote: Lowest sticker price on hardware, but proprietary storage drives and an uncosted migration make this the highest 5-year TCO of the four.
vendors.quoteText: We quote the most aggressive hardware price in this tender. Please note our storage array requires our proprietary drive caddies for any future capacity expansion; licensing and migration are the hospital's responsibility to arrange with the OEM and system integrator respectively.

vendors.name: Parimala InfoTech
vendors.exclusions: Licensing is separate; migration is quoted at a flat ₹9 lakh, payable once.
vendors.hiddenNote: A middling quote on both price and hidden exposure — migration cost is at least clearly stated up front.
vendors.quoteText: Our migration fee is fixed and stated up front at ₹9 lakh rather than estimated, so there is less ambiguity than some competing quotes, though licensing remains a separate OEM cost.

tenders.title: Housekeeping chemicals — rate contract
tenders.brief: Annual rate contract for housekeeping disinfectant/cleaning concentrates across all wings.

vendors.name: Clarion Chemtech
vendors.exclusions: The quoted 1:40 dilution assumes dosing via calibrated dispenser pumps (not supplied) — manual dosing typically runs closer to 1:25, raising actual consumption by roughly 35%.
vendors.installedBase: Existing housekeeping chemical vendor at 1 VPS unit.
vendors.hiddenNote: Cheapest quoted rate assumes dispenser-pump dosing at 1:40 — the hospital's manual dosing practice runs closer to 1:25, largely erasing the rate advantage in real consumption.
vendors.quoteText: Our concentrate is quoted at 1:40 dilution, our most economical rate. This dilution is validated with calibrated dispenser pumps; if dosing manually by jug/cap, actual consumption will run higher than the quoted annual litres.

vendors.name: Suprabha FM Solutions
vendors.exclusions: Standard 1:34 dilution, validated for manual dosing; no dispenser dependency.
vendors.hiddenNote: Higher headline rate, but the dilution ratio matches the hospital's actual manual dosing practice — no consumption surprise.
vendors.quoteText: Our 1:34 dilution rate is calibrated for manual dosing as practised on your housekeeping floor, so the quoted annual litres should match actual consumption closely, with no dispenser equipment needed.

vendors.name: GreenSpan Hygiene
vendors.exclusions: The quoted 1:45 dilution only holds with our colour-coded microfiber dosing system (not included, ₹4.2 lakh one-time); without it, actual dilution drifts to about 1:20.
vendors.installedBase: New vendor — no existing VPS Lakeshore installed base.
vendors.hiddenNote: Lowest litre rate, but the quoted dilution only holds with a microfiber dosing system that is not included in the price — without it, consumption roughly doubles.
vendors.quoteText: We quote our sharpest rate against our recommended 1:45 dilution, achievable with our colour-coded microfiber mopping and dosing system, offered separately at ₹4.2 lakh for a one-time hospital-wide rollout.

vendors.name: Amaltas Facility Care
vendors.exclusions: None notable.
vendors.hiddenNote: A balanced, realistic quote with no notable hidden costs.
vendors.quoteText: A straightforward quote at a realistic 1:36 dilution for manual dosing, with standard terms and no special equipment dependency.

PUR-2601.ourAsk: Match Vendor A/D on warranty (2 years) and include at least 1 tube replacement in the base CMC, given the 7-year exposure our comparison shows.
PUR-2601.vendorResponse: Agreed to extend standard warranty to 2 years. Tube remains outside CMC, but offered a 10% discount on the replacement tube (₹34.2L instead of ₹38L) if purchased within the warranty period.

PUR-2603.ourAsk: Given the 8% wastage risk we've modelled from short shelf-life stock, requested either 150+ day shelf life on arrival or a wastage rebate clause.
PUR-2603.vendorResponse: Agreed to a quarterly wastage rebate of up to 6% of invoiced value against documented short-expiry returns, in lieu of extending shelf life (manufacturing constraint).

PUR-2604.ourAsk: Requested an open-architecture firmware option or a discounted OEM cartridge rate given the 4-unit volume, to close the consumables-cost gap with Vendor B.
PUR-2604.vendorResponse: Declined to unlock open architecture (safety/warranty policy) but offered a 12% volume discount on OEM dialyzer cartridges for a 3-year supply commitment.

PUR-2605.ourAsk: Asked for the migration fee and 2 years of DB/OS licensing to be built into the capital quote rather than billed separately, for budget certainty.
PUR-2605.vendorResponse: Offered to cap the migration fee at ₹18L (from an open-ended estimate) and hold year-1 licensing at current rates, but declined to bundle beyond year 1.
